title: Vastu & Sacred Space Origins
description: The earliest concepts of aligning human settlements with cosmic laws (Vastu Shastra).
detailedDescription: Emergence of architectural principles based on cardinal directions and solar alignments. Early stone and timber structures show geometric planning linked to spiritual harmony.

title: Rig Vedic Oral Traditions
description: Composition of the core Rig Vedic hymns by ancient Rishis through oral transmission.
detailedDescription: The foundational period where the primary Veda was cognized and chanted. It focuses on the primary forces of nature (Devas) and the relationship between humanity and the divine through Yagya (sacrifice).

title: Upanishadic Philosophical Shift
description: Transition from external ritual to internal philosophical inquiry (Vedanta).
detailedDescription: A transformative era where seekers explored the nature of the self (Atman) and the ultimate reality (Brahman). This period gave birth to core Vedic philosophy and psychological insights.

title: The Epic Era & Bhagavad Gita
description: Codification of the Mahabharata and the emergence of the Bhagavad Gita.
detailedDescription: The Gita provides a practical path to spiritual liberation amidst the complexities of worldly life, synthesizing various paths of Yoga (Karma, Bhakti, Jnana).

title: Classical Yoga System
description: Patanjali's systematic codification of the Yoga philosophy.
detailedDescription: The Yoga Sutras organize the various practices into the Eight Limbs (Ashtanga Yoga), providing a scientific method for mastering the mind and attaining Samadhi.
